commitResults.messageTitle: Update relationship goal parts of the developer guide
commitResults.messageBody:
The developer guide still describes an outer rg/ field and an optional
own goal, and its manual tests add clients with an outer rg/. Since
relationship goals became partner criteria, the app rejects these
commands, so testers cannot follow the steps.

Let's remove the outdated internal representation section, move the
goals in the test fixtures into the criteria blocks, and rewrite the
relationship goal manual tests for criteria-only, keyword-only goals.
Let's also remove two leftover merge conflict markers.

Fixes #202

commitResults.messageTitle: Address review comments on the developer guide
commitResults.messageBody:
Reviewers asked to keep the relationship goal internal representation
section, to show criteria in the saved JSON as lists, and to separate
match-based groups from named groups.

Let's edit the internal representation section in place to describe
goals stored in the criteria, show the expected JSON criteria as lists,
and move the grp matches parsing and snapshot test notes into the
match-based groups section. Let's also restore the unchanged find rg/
paragraph and keep the manual test edits to the existing steps, so
fewer lines change.

commitResults.messageTitle: Describe relationship goals only as criteria in the developer guide
commitResults.messageBody:
Some lines still list the relationship goal among a client's own
details, for example in the religion test setup and a user story, and
the goal tests say "the goal" where they mean the goal preference.

Let's describe goals only as preference or dealbreaker criteria in
these lines, and fix the reasoning in the internal representation
section.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix the AI declaration formatting in the developer guide
commitResults.messageBody:
The AI declaration list in the acknowledgements has no blank line
before it or before the horizontal rule after it. Jekyll's kramdown
may render the list as one paragraph with literal asterisks. The last
item also calls the developer guide the "Documentation Guide".

Let's add the blank lines and correct the guide's name.

commitResults.messageTitle: Make the DG diagrams consistent and fix their loop guards
commitResults.messageBody:
Some diagrams use light fills with dark text while the rest use dark
fills with white text. Some loop and option guards in the sequence
diagrams are explanations rather than conditions. In the Storage
diagram the multiplicity labels overlap the package titles, and the
find-match diagram does not destroy the parser.

Let's use dark fills with white text in every class diagram, write the
guards as conditions, make room under the Storage package titles and
destroy the parser after it returns, and re-render the images.

Fixes #212

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Person, group matching and match outcome diagrams to the DG
commitResults.messageBody:
No diagram shows a client's contact fields or tags, the grp matches
command or how a match outcome is decided. These are explained only in
prose, which is harder to follow than the other features' diagrams.

Let's add a class diagram of the classes that make up a Person, a
sequence diagram for grp Candidates matches 1, and an activity diagram
for MatchAssessment#getOutcome(), each drawn from the current code.

commitResults.messageTitle: Identify malformed commands in syntax errors
commitResults.messageBody:
Generic syntax errors did not identify the command that needed correction. Pass the existing command word into the shared error template while retaining detailed usage and field-specific validation. Add regressions for syntax, empty input and unknown commands without changing argument acceptance.

This addresses the runtime portion of #200 with 36 lines of conservative functional-source churn.

Co-Authored-By: Codegraff <blackfloofie@codegraff.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Illustrate client criteria and matching workflows
commitResults.messageBody:
The guides lacked successful-command screenshots and implementation diagrams for recording and evaluating partner criteria. Add real application captures with fictional clients and reproducible commands, plus criteria and pairwise-match diagrams; reuse and correct the candidate-search sequence.

Keep diagrams consistent with set-valued criteria and derived relationship goals, and remove the ignored PlantUML padding setting that added a warning banner. Align UG error guidance with #200 while leaving unrelated feature documentation cleanups to their owners. This completes the documentation scope of #199 without functional-code changes.

Co-Authored-By: Codegraff <blackfloofie@codegraff.com>
Clarify command errors and illustrate criteria/matching workflows
Update relationship goal parts of the developer guide
Fix the AI declaration formatting in the developer guide
Make the DG diagrams consistent and add missing diagrams
